label: hero v2
goal: Buy one Trail Backpack with standard delivery. Your details: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States. Pay by card: name on card Alex Morgan, card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/30, security code 123. Agree to the terms of sale. You do not want newsletters or promotions.

outcome.reason: The order is confirmed by the payment oracle.

findings.problem: About 25 category links before any content and no skip link, so reaching products by Tab is very long; I had to use Shift+Tab wrap-around

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: Newsletter popup appears after opening cart and steals focus onto its close button; unwanted interruption
Delivery radios have no default selection; Tab lands on Express (the last option) so standard delivery needs an arrow key, which is not announced
Country dropdown starts on Choose a country; picking requires guessing ArrowDown
Focus resets to top of page after each page change, forcing long tab or wrap-around navigation on every page
Pay with PayPal button and card fields sit in embedded frames with only placeholder labels (CVV, MM / YY); no real labels, and no feedback after pressing Pay until the page was re-read

findings.problem: About 25 category links before any content and no skip link, so reaching products by Tab is very long; I had to use Shift+Tab wrap-around

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: Newsletter popup appears after opening cart and steals focus onto its close button; unwanted interruption
Delivery radios have no default selection; Tab lands on Express (the last option) so standard delivery needs an arrow key, which is not announced
Country dropdown starts on Choose a country; picking requires guessing ArrowDown
Focus resets to top of page after each page change, forcing long tab or wrap-around navigation on every page
Pay with PayPal button and card fields sit in embedded frames with only placeholder labels (CVV, MM / YY); no real labels, and no feedback after pressing Pay until the page was re-read
